commands: python -m senai.memory --project PROJECT --scope SCOPE [--user-id ID] profile-show NAME
python -m senai.memory --project PROJECT --scope SCOPE [--user-id ID] profile-propose NAME TEXT [--origin human|outcome] [--verified]
python -m senai.memory --project PROJECT --scope SCOPE [--user-id ID] profile-apply PROPOSAL_JSON --approve
python -m senai.memory --project PROJECT --scope SCOPE [--user-id ID] session-context REQUEST [--include-user] [--max-chars N]

inputs: existing build_prompt output plus bounded snapshot
outputs: executor result unchanged; exceptions propagate; no implicit retention

storage.namespace: canonical project + explicit scope; USER.md additionally uses authorized user_id
storage.migration_notes: Existing memory SQLite schema v1 unchanged. Add optional profiles/<namespace hash>/{SOUL.md,MEMORY.md}, users/<user hash>/USER.md and cooperative lock. No old state migration, auto-import or DB/file mirroring.

shared_file_changes: Proposed coordinator fresh-session loader and explicit snapshot reuse/refresh lifecycle; see integration-notes.md
Optional top-level CLI route; feature-local CLI works independently

limitations: Shared CLI/native session lifecycle/Telegram integration not wired or live-tested
SOUL origin/verified/approved fields rely on trusted caller authorization, not cryptographic proof
USER context must be explicitly excluded from shared sessions
WSL/POSIX fcntl required; standard library only
Curated limits 4000 chars/16000 bytes per file; total snapshot 8000 chars default; overflow errors
No semantic duplicate detection, automatic retention or file/DB synchronization
Credential pattern matching incomplete; local storage unencrypted; deletion not secure erasure
Cooperative locks protect our writers; external editors can race; no version history
Snapshots frozen in memory; cross-process native-session mapping left to coordinator
